meta.title: HULOL TECH
meta.description: HULOL TECH builds websites, mobile apps, and brand design for companies in Riyadh and the Gulf. The free consultation comes first.

about.title: About
about.body: HULOL TECH is a software company in Riyadh. Our scope is websites, mobile apps, and design.
about.storyTitle: We build the digital product that serves your business
about.storyP1: HULOL TECH is a software company in Riyadh working in three areas: websites, mobile apps, and design and branding.
about.storyP2: We start by understanding your business and goal before any talk of technology, then write the scope and deliverables in a clear proposal, and build with you step by step.
about.valuesIntro: Four principles we apply on every project.

clarity.title: Clarity in writing
clarity.text: Scope, deliverables, and payments are written in a clear proposal before work starts.

arabic.title: Arabic first
arabic.text: We design right-to-left from the ground up, and deliver an English version with the same care.

visibility.title: See your progress
visibility.text: We show you the result at every stage, so you are not waiting until the end.

support.text: Warranty and technical support after delivery, and you can continue on a support and maintenance plan.
